verify.md	dross trust --check
verify.md	dross verify <phase> [--skip-mutation]
verify.md	dross verify <phase> --detach            # returns immediately; the run outlives the connection
verify.md	dross verify <phase> --detach --at 02:00 # same, but the host starts it off-hours
verify.md	dross verify status                       # what is in flight, and where
verify.md	dross verify results <phase>              # collect it; writes tests.json + verify.toml
verify.md	dross issue phase sync <phase> --status uat
verify.md	dross survivor accept <file>:<line> --op <OP> --reason "<why it is permanently acceptable>"
verify.md	dross survivor route  <file>:<line> --op <OP> --target <phase-slug>
verify.md	- **`pass`**
verify.md	- **`partial`**
verify.md	- **`fail`**
verify.md	dross verify finalize <phase-id>
verify.md	dross state set current_phase_status verified
verify.md	dross state touch "verified <phase-id>: <verdict> (<criteria-covered>/<total>, mutation <score>)"
verify.md	git add .dross/phases/<phase-id>/verify.toml .dross/phases/<phase-id>/tests.json
verify.md	git commit -m "chore(dross): record verify for <phase-id> (<verdict>)"
verify.md	dross phase list         — see all phases (--milestone <version> for one roadmap)
verify.md	dross milestone show     — review milestone status before tagging the release
verify.md	- **Follow the interaction playbook (`_interaction.md`); verify.toml is never a review medium.**
verify.md	- **Don't fake coverage.**
verify.md	- **Capture a stated preference as a rule, don't apply it ad hoc.**
verify.md	- **Don't write tests yourself.**
verify.md	- **Don't skip the cross-check.**
verify.md	- **Single pass, no checker loop.**
